annotation.title_clean: Part 791—Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain (15 CFR Part 791)
annotation.title_en: Part 791—Securing the Information and Communications Technology and Services Supply Chain (15 CFR Part 791)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security
annotation.summary_en: US Commerce Department regulation (15 CFR Part 791) establishing ICTS supply-chain review against foreign adversaries, plus Subpart D prohibiting Chinese- or Russian-linked connected-vehicle software and hardware enabling automated driving and connectivity systems, with declarations of conformity, authorizations, and IEEPA penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Secretary may review and prohibit ICTS transactions involving foreign adversary-linked suppliers posing undue risk.
Scope covers drones, AI, autonomous systems and robotics as critical and emerging technologies.
Subpart D bans import/sale of connected vehicles with PRC/Russia-linked covered software and VCS hardware.
Manufacturers and importers must file Declarations of Conformity with due diligence, SBOM/HBOM records.
General and specific authorizations, appeals, and IEEPA civil and criminal penalties apply.
